about: Who's behind each data source shown on the Politics tab. Plain facts only, each with a citation and an 'as of' date. Items marked 'reported' come from news reports and were not confirmed by the company or a filing. Edit this file to update; the tab reloads it on every view.

orgs.name: Polymarket
orgs.kind: Prediction market (data source on this tab)
orgs.summary: Private company founded in 2020 by Shayne Coplan; investors include Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE's parent), 1789 Capital and Founders Fund; U.S. exchange arm is CFTC-designated.

facts.t: Blockratize, Inc., a Delaware corporation headquartered in New York, owns and operates polymarket.com and does business as "Polymarket" (per a 2022 CFTC order).

cite.title: CFTC order, In re Blockratize, Inc. (Jan 3, 2022)

facts.t: QCX LLC operates under the assumed name "Polymarket US" and is listed by the CFTC as a Designated Contract Market (designated July 9, 2025).

cite.title: CFTC DCM filing 49571: QCX LLC d/b/a Polymarket US

facts.t: Privately held, venture- and strategically-funded company; founded by Shayne Coplan in 2020, who is Founder and CEO.
Acquired the holding company of QCX, LLC (exchange) and QC Clearing LLC (clearinghouse), together "QCEX", for $112 million.
May 2024: $45M Series B led by Founders Fund, with 1confirmation, ParaFi, Vitalik Buterin and Dragonfly; a prior $25M Series A was led by General Catalyst ($70M total announced).
Aug 2025: strategic investment from 1789 Capital; Donald Trump Jr. joined Polymarket's advisory board. Amount not disclosed by the company.
Oct 2025: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) agreed to invest up to $2 billion at about an $8 billion pre-investment valuation; ICE also became a distributor of Polymarket data.

Mar 2026: ICE completed a further $600 million direct cash investment and expected to buy up to $40 million of securities from existing holders, completing its obligations ($1 billion initial investment in Oct 2025).
Aug 2026: $1 billion round led by 1789 Capital (about $300 million) at a $21 billion post-money valuation; other participants not identified.
An earlier 2026 round included new investment from D.E. Shaw & Co.

Users buy and sell outcome shares; trades on the international platform are matched peer-to-peer through smart contracts. Revenue comes from the exchange business; ICE distributes Polymarket data to institutional clients.
Jan 2022: CFTC settled charges that Blockratize operated an unregistered event-market facility; $1.4 million civil penalty and wind-down of non-compliant markets.
Nov 2025: CFTC amended Polymarket US's order of designation to permit intermediated trading through futures commission merchants.
Described by ICE as the Official Prediction Market Partner of X and of Stocktwits.
Donald Trump Jr. is a partner at 1789 Capital and an adviser to Polymarket.

orgs.name: Kalshi
orgs.kind: Prediction market (data source on this tab)
orgs.summary: Private company founded in 2018 by Tarek Mansour and Luana Lopes Lara; KalshiEX LLC is a CFTC-designated contract market; investors include Sequoia, Paradigm, Coatue, Wellington and Andreessen Horowitz.

facts.t: KalshiEX LLC, designated by the CFTC as a contract market in November 2020.

cite.title: CFTC Order of Designation, KalshiEX LLC

facts.t: Kalshi Klear LLC, an affiliate, is registered with the CFTC as a derivatives clearing organization (Aug 2024).
Privately held, venture-funded; co-founded in 2018 by Tarek Mansour (CEO) and Luana Lopes Lara; a Y Combinator company.
Feb 2021: $30M Series A led by Sequoia.
Dec 2025: $1B Series E at an $11B valuation led by Paradigm, with Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz, Meritech, IVP, ARK Invest, Anthos, CapitalG and Y Combinator.
May 2026: $1B Series F at a $22B valuation led by Coatue, with Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, Paradigm, Morgan Stanley and ARK Invest.

Oct 2026: $1B Series G at a $40B post-money valuation co-led by Wellington and Sequoia, with Baillie Gifford, Stripes, Andreessen Horowitz, Coatue, Layer Global, Morgan Stanley Investment Management, Sequoia Global Equities, CapitalG, Hudson River Trading and Balyasny.
CNBC has a commercial relationship with Kalshi that includes customer acquisition and a minority investment, per CNBC's own disclosure.
Exchange revenue from trading fees; Kalshi's series data lists a fee type per series (e.g. 'quadratic').
Regulated by the CFTC as a designated contract market (KalshiEX LLC) with an affiliated registered clearinghouse (Kalshi Klear LLC).
May 2025: the CFTC moved to drop its appeal in KalshiEX LLC v. CFTC, the case over Kalshi's election-outcome contracts.
Named Donald Trump Jr. a strategic adviser in January 2025.

orgs.name: The Associated Press
orgs.kind: Resolution source named in market rules (not a pollster)
orgs.summary: Independent not-for-profit news cooperative; many election markets on this tab name its race calls as the resolution source.

facts.t: Independent, not-for-profit news cooperative, historically owned by its member newspapers and broadcasters; no outside shareholders.

Content licensing to news organizations was about 82% of 2023 revenue; other income includes services, software, broadcast facilities, advertising, data/AI licensing, reader donations and philanthropy.
Created the AP Fund for Journalism, a separate 501(c)(3) nonprofit, to raise philanthropic support for local and state news.
Named as the resolution source in the rules of election markets shown here (e.g. Polymarket's state Senate and Governor winner markets); the AP is not a party to those markets.

cite.title: Example market rules: Polymarket Montana Senate Election Winner
